_about: Hand corrections to v1 answer keys, by 'verse|word'. 'accept' replaces the key; 'drop' removes the question (its key can't be settled from the form and context). Applied by bench/generate_v1.py.

3.51.4|jajñuḥ.why: sakhyas tā jajñur iṅgitaiḥ: the friends knew (her state) from her gestures. Perfect of jñā; the corpus has jan.

3.71.21|abhijajñe.why: nābhijajñe sa nṛpatiḥ: the king did not recognise (him). Perfect of abhi-jñā; the corpus has abhi-jan, 'was born'.

3.61.98|agamaḥ.why: aho batāyam agamaḥ śrīmān: 'this splendid mountain' (a-gama, 'not moving'), Damayantī addressing the mountain. The corpus has an aorist of gam.

3.71.3|samahṛṣyanta.drop: Ātmanepada imperfect of a fourth-class root: middle and passive look the same, and the answer format only offers active or passive.

3.74.15|tārābhyām.drop: Final member of the bahuvrīhi kṛṣṇatāra qualifying netra: lemma (tārā or tāra), gender (that of the head) and case (ablative or instrumental) are all arguable.

3.78.19|varebhyaḥ.drop: -bhyaḥ is dative or ablative; the corpus says dative and every model says ablative. Needs a reading of the passage before it can be a question.
